title: Single-cell RNA sequencing uncovers an immunosuppressive program in PDAC mast cells: tumour-driven activation, proliferation, and association with Treg recruitment.
snippet: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is characterized by a highly immunosuppressive tumour microenvironment (TME), which contributes to its resistance to immunotherapy. title: From dysbiosis to precision oncology: translational role of the microbiome in gastrointestinal cancer.
snippet: Gastrointestinal (GI) cancers, including colorectal, gastric, pancreatic, hepatocellular, and esophageal malignancies, remain a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide.
